stem: The children sang a loud song.
The teacher began and then clapped.
The wind blew my red hat.
The wet cat hid under bed.
We heard the loud bell ring.
The fish swam in the pond.
My dad built a small fort.
The cold rain froze on glass.
The boy drew a yellow sun.
The kid dug a deep hole.
Mom spoke in a quiet way.
The kid drew a gray cat.
The dog barked and bit shoe.
He packed bag and drove away.
We cleaned room and kept toy.
She cleaned coat and wore it.
The class clapped and then began.
We clapped and then sang loud.
The kid smiled and then hid.
I fixed toy and then broke it.
We clapped and stood by door.
She called Mom and told news.
We waved card and kite flew.
We packed seed and it grew.
He clapped loud and woke early.
We smiled and caught big bugs.
She smiled and chose the gift.
We packed fort and hung flag.
We cleaned up and ice froze.
We packed juice and left table.
She called out and heard reply.
We fixed bike and then slid.
He cleaned hole and felt tired.
We smiled wide and kept calm.
